summary: Trello's main friction themes are simplicity vs. complexity, reliability, pricing, and user experience.

themes.name: Simplicity vs. Complexity
themes.description: Users appreciate Trello's simplicity but feel it's becoming dated and less intuitive over time. Some find it too basic for complex project management needs, while others prefer its straightforward approach over more complex tools like Jira or Asana.
themes.recommendation: Maintain simplicity while adding more customization and structure for advanced users.

themes.name: User Experience and Interface
themes.description: Users find the interface confusing, especially with recent updates that added friction (e.g., moving the 'Attachment' button). Some feel the app is not intuitive for managing tasks and projects efficiently.
themes.recommendation: Simplify the UI, reduce friction in workflows, and improve discoverability of key features.

themes.name: Reliability and Stability
themes.description: Users report frequent data loss, app freezes, and syncing issues, especially with the inbox widget and cross-device sync. These issues disrupt workflow and reduce trust in the app's reliability.
themes.recommendation: Fix data loss, improve syncing, and stabilize the inbox widget and cross-device experience.

themes.name: Pricing and Value
themes.description: Users are frustrated with the recent price increases, especially the shift to annual billing and the lack of transparency. Some feel the cost is no longer justified for the features provided.
themes.recommendation: Offer more flexible pricing models and ensure value is clearly communicated.
